changeSet.comment: Move active legacy attempts without an immutable submerchant snapshot to manual review.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE payments SET status = 'VERIFY_PENDING', failure_reason = '{payment.verification.pending}', next_verification_at = NULL WHERE is_deleted = false AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'VERIFY_PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW') AND provider_token IS NOT NULL AND provider_submerchant_key IS NULL;
